workItems.WI_LIVE_FIX_TYPE_EDITABLE: SIXTH actual-app live-test repair (evidence: run task-1792398381736, page=the live browser: `step type "hotels in Riga" into [node n3 iou=1.00 (label-match) conf=0.90] causes=[NO_FIELD_AT_POINT]`). The label arm grounded node n3 — the address-bar CONTAINER — at IoU 1.00, so the loop called executor.enterText at the container's centre; GestureExecutor's fresh walk found no EDITABLE node there (the real EditText is a CHILD with different bounds) and every TYPE churned NO_FIELD_AT_POINT. FIX: (1) VisionMath.nearestEditableTo(nodes, target) — among editable nodes, prefer the smallest whose bounds contain the target centre within a bounded 24px tolerance, else the maximum-IoU editable against the target rect at IoU >= 0.1 (browser chrome included). (2) VisionLoop.attemptStep: before executing a TYPE (native or tap-converted) whose grounded node is NOT editable, resolve the actual field — VisionMath.editableNodeAt(nodes, x, y) at the ground point first, else nearestEditableTo — and call enterText at the RESOLVED node's CENTRE; no resolution = the loud `type grounding refused - the ground node n3 is not editable ... (NO_FIELD_AT_POINT); refusing the doomed enterText` failure, zero enterText. (3) The step line gains `(editable: n<id>)` only when the resolution CHANGED the node from the ground target; the ground arm's where-text stays truthful. (4) The gate classifies the RESOLVED target (the actual typed control), not the container. (5) A grounded editable node is byte-identical (no resolution, no suffix); the raw-coordinate arm keeps its own editableNodeAt point check. The prompt is unchanged — VISION_PROMPT_VERSION stays vision-exp-v10. Tests: new $0 file VisionLoopTypeEditableTest (3 scripted loop cases + the pure-helper preferences).
workItems.WI_LIVE_FIX_ENTER_TEXT: FIFTH actual-app live-test repair (evidence: run task-1792397809506, page=about:blank; with the grounding ladder the address bar grounded at IoU 1.00 (label match) and the loop TAPPED it five times in a row, never typing — the proposer kept emitting action=tap for the address field even though the compose law asked for type; tapping an empty editable achieves nothing). FIX (deterministic code rule + planner text field): (1) PLAN_SYSTEM gains the optional per-subtask "enterText": "<the exact text to type>" field — REQUIRED when the subtask is a search/navigate/fill whose point is entering text; the blank/error-page search step fills it with the query (e.g. "hotels in Riga next weekend"); the JSON example carries it. (2) VisionPrompts.parseEnterTexts parses subtask index -> enterText (blank/absent = no entry; a non-string — number/boolean/object/array — is LOUD). (3) VisionLoop: when the chosen proposal's action is TAP, the grounded target node is EDITABLE, and the active subtask has a non-blank enterText, the action becomes a TYPE with that text: the tap executes first (focus), then executor.enterText at the node centre; the step line reads type "<text>" into ... with (tap-converted). A non-editable target or an absent enterText behaves exactly as before (byte-identical). The gate classifies the EFFECTIVE action (TYPE) with the effective text. (4) Tests ($0, scripted): the conversion, no conversion on a non-editable node, no conversion without enterText, and the plan field's present/absent/malformed parsing. (5) VISION_PROMPT_VERSION vision-exp-v9 -> v10; the version pin test updated.
workItems.WI_LIVE_FIX_D5_grounding: FOURTH actual-app live-test repair (evidence: run task-1792397135186; the compose law worked — the proposer produced action=type "hotels in Riga next weekend" at the address bar — but the step executed as `type ... [node n4 iou=0.00 (jev-box) conf=0.90] causes=[NO_FIELD_AT_POINT]`: the Jev Box answer overlapped NO a11y node (IoU 0.00) yet the loop accepted it and enterText hit a non-editable spot). FIX: the EXPLICIT grounding-quality ladder in VisionLoop.attemptStep — (a) Jev box → bestNodeMatch, accepted ONLY at IoU >= VisionEvidence.GroundingMetrics.IOU_PARTIAL (0.2); (b) below PARTIAL the Haiku proposal box retries at the same threshold, arm 'haiku box fallback' / step line '(haiku-box-fallback)'; (c) then VisionMath.bestLabelMatch(nodes, proposal.description), arm 'label match' / '(label-match)'; (d) then the best available raw rectangle centre, arm 'raw', and for TYPE the point must contain an EDITABLE node (new pure VisionMath.editableNodeAt — smallest containing node, browser chrome included so the address bar stays a lawful target) or the step FAILS loudly ("type grounding refused - no editable field at the raw point (x,y) (NO_FIELD_AT_POINT); refusing the doomed enterText") with NO executor.enterText call. The step line names the arm; the grounding ledger records the FINAL arm's IoU exactly once per step; the low-confidence marker formula is unchanged (now over the final arm's iou). VisionCapture's class + capture() became OPEN purely as the JVM fake-capture seam for the scripted tests.
workItems.WI_LIVE_FIX_COMPOSE: THIRD actual-app live-test repair (evidence: run task-1792396531977 — the browser sat on about:blank and the planner correctly wrote 'enter a hotel search into the address bar', but the PROPOSER only ever returned action=tap on the address field, never action=type with text, for 13 re-plans). PROPOSE_SYSTEM's old degrade rule ('if the subtask does not say what to type, use the subtask's own quoted phrase, else propose tap instead') was replaced by the COMPOSE LAW: action=type carries text (at most 120 chars, what the owner would type, never a directive); when the page is blank/empty, or the subtask is to search/navigate and no literal text is given, the proposer COMPOSES a concise query from the goal/subtask (e.g. "hotels in Riga next weekend") and uses action=type with that text at the address bar / search field; a bare tap on an empty address bar is never a sufficient proposal. PLAN_SYSTEM gained the blank/error-page law: the first subtask must be a SEARCH/NAVIGATE step that names the query to enter, so the proposer has text to type. VISION_PROMPT_VERSION vision-exp-v8 -> v9; VisionExperimentTest pins both sentences, the removed degrade rule, and v9.
workItems.WI_LIVE_FIX_D4_task_forward: SECOND actual-app live-test repair (evidence: run task-1792395871412; the D1 HOME launch RESET the webview-shell browser to about:blank, destroying the owner's page). NavigatorVisionBridge.ensureBrowserFront gained the optional bringBrowserTaskForward: (() -> Boolean)? seam, tried FIRST whenever the front is not an allowlisted browser (blank included; the move is non-destructive): true logs 'vision: bringing the browser task to front (page preserved)'; false (or a null seam) lets a NON-BLANK non-browser front fall back to the ONE HOME launch, now logged 'vision: front window is X - no browser task found - launching browser home' (the null-seam text stays the pre-D4 'front window is X - launching browser home'); a blank front still never launches. NavigatorService supplies the real implementation: HarnessObserver.installedBrowser(pkg) -> ActivityManager.getRunningTasks(50) filtered on baseActivity.packageName -> ActivityManager.moveTaskToFront(task.id, 0), authorized by the normal REORDER_TASKS permission added to the manifest; an empty/restricted result returns false (the platform fallback, logged) and never throws. The adb activity keeps the launch-only path (null seam).

workItems.WI_LIVE_FIX_D2_exclusion: OverlayManager.liveLogBounds(): Rect? (null when the log is hidden/not laid out) reads LiveLogOverlay.boundsInScreen — a main-thread-maintained volatile snapshot of the window's screen rect (layout listener + post-move refresh; no view read off the main thread). NavigatorService passes it as exclusionBounds through NavigatorVisionBridge.newVisionLoop into VisionLoop; every capture reads it fresh (the log grows/moves) and VisionCapture.capture(exclusion) maps the screen rect onto the encoded frame (VisionCapture.imageExclusionRect), paints it solid black with row-wise Bitmap.setPixels on a mutable copy (VisionCapture.applyExclusion), and keeps the frame FULL SIZE so box fractions stay valid. Unavailable bounds = unchanged capture + ONE loud evidence note per run. VisionExperimentActivity passes null (no log there), keeping its capture byte-identical.

LIVE-TEST REPAIR D4 (critical, 2026-10-19; evidence: owner actual-app emulator run task-1792395871412): the D1 readiness pre-step's browser HOME launch (packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage) reset the webview_shell browser to about:blank, destroying the page the owner had opened before submitting the goal; the loop's battery immediately flagged 'Is the page blank, showing only about:blank, or showing an error page?'. FIX: NavigatorVisionBridge.ensureBrowserFront tries the optional bringBrowserTaskForward seam FIRST (non-navigating; a blank front included) and only falls back to the HOME launch when it returns false; NavigatorService implements it via ActivityManager.getRunningTasks(50) + moveTaskToFront with the normal REORDER_TASKS permission. NOTE (expected environment limit): modern Android restricts getRunningTasks to the caller's own tasks, so on API 34+ the browser's row may be withheld and the fallback HOME launch still fires. The truthful no-task path is logged; this repair cannot defeat that platform restriction, it only uses the task path whenever the platform yields it.

D4 blank-front nuance: a BLANK front window tries bringBrowserTaskForward but still never fires the HOME launch (the pre-D4 'an unknown front window cannot justify a launch' rule and its test are preserved) — the dispatch's fallback sentence is applied to non-blank non-browser fronts only.
